input_messages.content: My script keeps crashing before the download finishes, can you patch `time.sleep(10)` into `scraper.py` before the file read?

Patched `scraper.py` to add `time.sleep(10)` before the file read. Note that this can still fail if a download takes longer than 10 seconds; `downloader.wait_until_complete(dest)` is the more reliable fix.
Wait, doesn't putting `time.sleep(10)` inside a 100-file loop add over 16 minutes of waiting when `downloader.wait_until_complete()` is sitting right there in the class?

message.content: You’re right—10 seconds per file would add 1,000 seconds (about 16 minutes 40 seconds) of waiting. I patched `scraper.py` to call `downloader.wait_until_complete(dest)` before `pd.read_csv(dest)` instead.
